steps.evidence: No contributor docs; CI builds and tests the crate via 'just lint test' (ci.yml:57), which runs cargo inside nix-shell (justfile:17-20, 35). Cargo.lock is committed.

optionalSteps.evidence: justfile:4-35 runs every fmt/lint/test recipe through 'nix-shell --pure' (shell.nix provides stable + nightly Rust, cargo-nextest, shells, linters); .envrc 'use nix' for direnv

notes: There is no CONTRIBUTING or development doc. README's Installation section only installs a released binary (install script, package managers, or 'cargo install zoxide --locked' from crates.io) and then hooks it into the shell; it never builds the local clone. readmeCommands record the Linux/WSL recommended path plus the Bash hook line (which README says to add to the end of ~/.bashrc); other OS/shell variants are omitted. Local development is therefore by Cargo convention: cargo build / cargo run. zoxide is a CLI without a default action, so a useful run passes a subcommand (e.g. 'cargo run -- init bash', 'cargo run -- query foo'); there is no port. The maintainers' own workflow (justfile, CI) is Nix-based: 'just test' = cargo nextest in nix-shell; on Windows plain 'cargo +stable test'. MSRV is rust-version 1.88.0 (Cargo.toml:12, checked by cargo msrv verify in 'just lint'); edition 2024. .cargo/config.toml defines an xtask alias, but there is no xtask package.
